messages.gpu: Cartoon 3D renders on the GPU only (on the CPU a 90-second Short takes about 50 minutes). No renderer has a working GPU: configure one with `python onboard.py --step gpu` or add a GPU renderer, test it under Settings → Rendering → Renderers on the dashboard, or choose another visual style.
messages.gpu_unknown: Cartoon 3D renders on the GPU only, and no renderer has tested its GPU yet (each does so when it starts, and on Test GPU under Settings → Rendering → Renderers). Test it first, then choose the style.

picture.opening: Shot 1 is already in motion at frame 0: a character mid-action on the set the first sentence names, the camera moving.
picture.turn: A cut to a new shot on the first word of a turn or a re-opening, or a punch-in or an impact kick at that moment.
picture.payoff: The shot with the answer, held longest, with the camera's strongest move.
picture.ending: Hold on the payoff picture to the last frame. No closing card, logo, recap or sign-off after it.

best_for: a place and people moving through it: a story, a walkthrough with a protagonist
avoid_for: packet diagrams and other pure mechanisms
signals: characters walk and react in one world
